title: The Borrowed Portrait Anew
author: Jude Halloran
blurb: Quentin Nystrom, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
